title: OtterBox Google Pixel 9 Pro XL Defender Series Case

comparisons.notes: OtterBox Defender Series for Pixel 9 / 9 Pro / 9 Pro XL; XL Black selectable; live US price $48.71 (was $64.95); matches Woot title/ASIN product line; MPN 77-95633

writeup: Woot has a new OtterBox Defender Series case for the Google Pixel 9 Pro XL (MPN 77-95633, Black) at $9.99. The multi-layer Defender includes a holster and a kickstand. Google Store currently lists the Pixel 9 Pro XL black Defender at $48.71, and Visions Electronics has the exact 77-95633 model in stock for C$99.99. That is 79 percent and about $39 below Google Store. Quantity is 4+ left, with a limit of 4 per customer.
